item.title: How to Check If a Phone Is Stolen Using IMEI - Complete Guide
item.description: Learn how to check if a phone is stolen before you buy it. Complete guide to IMEI verification, what to look for when buying used phones, and how to protect yourself from purchasing stolen smartphones.
item.dc:creator: Safe or Stolen Team
item.content:encoded:
How to Check If a Phone Is Stolen Using IMEI

Before buying a used smartphone, it's crucial to verify the phone isn't stolen. Our free IMEI check helps you avoid legal troubles and financial loss.

What Is IMEI and Why Check It?

The International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI) is a unique 15-digit number that identifies every mobile device. When phones are reported stolen, their IMEI numbers are added to blacklist databases.

How to Find Your Phone's IMEI

  • Dial *#06# on the phone
  • Check Settings > About Phone > IMEI
  • Look on the original box or SIM tray

item.dc:creator: Safe or Stolen Team
item.content:encoded:
VIN Lookup: How to Check If a Car Is Stolen

Buying a stolen car can result in its confiscation, legal problems, and complete financial loss. Our VIN lookup service helps you verify any vehicle's status before purchase.

Where to Find a Vehicle's VIN Number

  • Dashboard on driver's side (visible through windshield)
  • Driver's side door jamb sticker
  • Engine block
  • Title and registration documents
